header.name: mcs51_health_pot relay dwell: WARM re-energize gated by min-off-time, OFF edges immediate

steps.description: Boot: state OFF, heater relay off
Cold water BEFORE first 100 ms control tick: ADC0832 code ~240 -> 25 C (valueNorm = 240/4095, low-byte rail convention)
ON pressed in cold water: HEAT state, heater relay on (boot seeds relay_off_sec=255 so first heat-up is never dwell-gated)
Water reaches boil: code ~50 -> ~98 C (>= 98 C threshold); heater cuts at ~1.7 s, 3 s boil hold follows
Boil reached: heater cuts off immediately (OFF edge is never dwell-gated)
After 3 s boil hold: WARM state, keep-warm indicator lit (default setpoint 60 C)

Water cools to ~50 C (code ~175; LUT interp 40+(60-40)*(200-175)/(200-150)=50 C; 175/4095=0.0427). 50 < 60-3 => bang-bang requests heat. Relay has been off since ~1.7 s (> 3 s dwell) so re-energize is allowed
Dwell already satisfied (off > 3 s): heater re-energizes normally in WARM
Water heats back to ~98 C (code ~50; > 60+3): bang-bang requests OFF. Injected just after the 7.0 s tick so the cut-off lands at the 7.1 s control tick, making the dwell window deterministic
Too-hot cut-off is IMMEDIATE (7.1 s tick) even though the relay was only on ~1 s — OFF edges bypass dwell
Water immediately cools to ~50 C again (code ~175): bang-bang requests heat, but the relay has been off only ~0.5 s (< 3 s RELAY_DWELL_SECONDS) so re-energize must be withheld
Dwell window: at the 9.0 s tick relay_off_sec=2 (<3) so heater stays OFF despite the cold request — contact-life min-off-time enforced

9 s and 10 s telemetry frames both report WARM (S=2) with heater held off (H=0) by dwell. one_second_task runs after control_task in each 1 s tick, so relay_off_sec increments at whole-second boundaries: off at 7.1 s -> 8 s=1, 9 s=2, 10 s=3
Dwell satisfied: 10 s tick counts relay_off_sec=3, so the 11.0 s control tick finally re-energizes the heater (not at 10.1 s — the 1 s counter granularity)
11 s telemetry frame (emitted after control_task in the 11.0 s tick) reports WARM (S=2) heater now on (H=1)
